native_assessment_definition.name: PSSA school totals · grades 3–8
native_assessment_definition.original_numerical_name: 2024–25 Pennsylvania regular PSSA All Students / Total grades 3–8
native_assessment_definition.grades: Pure lower profiles with positive October grades 3–8; original regular PSSA All Students / Total accountable scored scope
native_assessment_definition.standard: Original published Percent Proficient and above; scored accountable regular PSSA population, one-decimal rounding and fewer-than-11 suppression. Keystone and PASA remain separate.

count_definition_status.reason: Every eligible rate has its exact original same-year regular PSSA All Students/Total Number Scored denominator; source floor is 11, observed minimum 42. Combined retains both subject counts and uses the smaller only for display, never a paired denominator.

release_basis.note: Only this separately validated exact 2024–25 grade-school regular PSSA contract is approved. Both historical audits keep false approvals. Every model member has its verified original scored count and conditional sampling interval. High, mixed, primary, inactive and unmatched scopes remain outside.
